title: WISDOM project - XVIII. Molecular gas distributions and kinematics of three megamaser galaxies
question: Which megamaser galaxies are suitable targets for cross-checking maser and cold molecular gas SMBH mass measurements, and what are their molecular gas distributions and kinematics?

what.value: Maser SMBH masses, distances and sigma_star for the parent sample

evidence.quote: We use the compilation of SMBH mass measurements of (cite: vdBosch2016ApJ831.134) as our starting point, including all maser measurements in their Tables 2 and 3.

what.value: VLA 8.4 and 4.9 GHz fluxes of NGC 3393 components

evidence.quote: Combining our measurements with those of (cite: Koss+2015ApJ807.149) at $8.4$ and $4.9$ GHz, we fit power laws

what.value: Maser VLBI astrometry used as galaxy centres

evidence.quote: We used the astrometry from the existing VLBI observations to define the centre of each galaxy

recipe.method: Apply criteria on SoI angular radius, HST dust disc regularity and declination to maser parent sample
assumptions: M_BH ∝ D when rescaling masses to updated distances

recipe.goal: Calibrate and image ALMA CO(2-1) cubes and continuum
recipe.method: Pipeline calibration; uvcontsub; tclean multiscale with interactive masks; primary beam correction

recipe.goal: Make moment maps, spectra and PVDs
recipe.method: Smoothed-cube mask (1.5 RMS threshold), hole/island filling, applied to unsmoothed PB-corrected cube; PVD with 2" mock slit along kinematic major axis
key_parameters: Fill holes < 2 beams; remove islands < 1 beam

recipe.goal: Derive integrated fluxes and molecular gas masses
recipe.method: Sum masked spectra; uncertainty from RMS of masked sums over line-free channels; mass from CO(2-1) flux with R21=1 and alpha_CO=4.3
assumptions: R21 = 1; alpha_CO = 4.3 Msun pc-2 (K km/s)-1 including heavy elements; adopted distances

recipe.goal: Measure 230-GHz continuum sources and spectral indices
recipe.method: 2D Gaussian fits with imfit; power-law SED fit with VLA fluxes for NGC 3393

recipe.goal: Reduce JCMT spectra and compare with ALMA
recipe.method: ORAC-DR in Starlink, rebin to 10 km/s, linear baseline, S=15.6 T_A*/eta_A with eta_A=0.52

recipe.goal: Estimate observing time needed for SMBH mass measurement
recipe.method: Take central peak pixel, assume homogeneous gas, target beam ~ theta_SoI, S/N=5 per beam in 10 km/s channels, use ALMA OT
assumptions: Homogeneous molecular gas within the central beam

evidence.quote: we estimate using the ALMA Observing Tool (OT) that the observations would require a total observing time of $\approx70$ days.
results in a total of $\approx100$ years.
results in a total of $\approx80$ days.

score_reason: Public data and clearly stated imaging parameters (robust, channel width, clean depth, CASA version); manual masks and channel selection are unspecified, but results are simple integrated quantities.
rediscovery_reason: Public ALMA data, a mostly complete imaging recipe and numeric outputs (fluxes, masses, continuum fluxes) that can be reproduced.
